title: DBP overview
description: Database Access Platform: connections through proxy and gateway, logical vs physical, statements, latency, pools, governance, client-side Hikari pools.

options.content:
**Database Access Platform – overview.** Scraped by `deploy/monitoring/prometheus.yml`. Exact metric names and labels (see `docs/operations.md`, Metrics catalogue):
gateway `dbp_gateway_logical_sessions{datasource}`, `dbp_gateway_pinned_sessions{datasource}`, `dbp_gateway_pool_{active,idle,waiting,total,max}{datasource}`, `dbp_gateway_statements_total{datasource,operation,success}`, `dbp_gateway_statement_duration_seconds_bucket{datasource}`, `dbp_gateway_errors_total{sqlstate}`, `dbp_gateway_telemetry_dropped_total` · proxy `dbp_proxy_connections_active{listener,application,datasource,backend}`, `dbp_proxy_connections_live`, `dbp_proxy_connections_{accepted,refused,failed}_total{listener[,reason]}`, `dbp_proxy_bytes_{in,out}_bytes_total{listener}`, `dbp_proxy_backend_connect_seconds{listener,backend,quantile}`, `dbp_proxy_telemetry_events_dropped` · control plane: Spring Boot defaults only (`http_server_requests_seconds_*{uri,status}`, `hikaricp_*`, `jvm_*`; no custom `dbp_*` meters — platform counts live in the REST API) · examples `hikaricp_connections_active{pool}` (orders-service only).

Gateway meters carry no `application` label (per-application numbers come from `GET /stats/queries/top`), so the *Application* variable filters proxy panels only. The gateway story is **logical vs physical**; the proxy story is **connections by application**.

panels.title: Gateway logical sessions
panels.description: Driver connections open against the gateway (what applications think they have).

panels.title: Gateway physical connections
panels.description: Pooled database connections actually open (what the database sees from the gateway).

panels.title: Proxy connections
panels.description: Pass-through connections currently open through the proxy.

panels.title: Error ratio (gateway, 5m)
panels.description: Failed statements / all statements. >1% warning, >5% critical.

panels.title: Telemetry events dropped (1h)
panels.description: Events lost by gateway (dbp_gateway_telemetry_dropped_total) and proxy (dbp_proxy_telemetry_events_dropped, a monotonic gauge) over the last hour.

panels.title: Gateway: logical sessions vs physical connections
panels.description: The many-logical-to-few-physical effect: run reporting-batch (20 logical) and watch physical stay at the pool size. Pinned = sessions inside a transaction/with open cursors.

panels.title: Proxy: connections by application
panels.description: Pass-through connections attributed by service alias / program name. 'unknown' = no identity rule matched.

panels.title: Proxy: accepted, refused and failed / min
panels.description: Refusals: quota (maxProxyConnections), unknown_service (no datasource/alias), backend_failed.

panels.title: Gateway: pool waiting / idle per datasource
panels.description: Waiting > 0 for long means the datasource pool (poolPolicy.maxConnections) is too small for the load.

panels.title: Client side: HikariCP pools of the examples
panels.description: HikariCP meters of the three orders-service variants (legacy-reporting bundles no Prometheus registry).

panels.title: Statements / s by datasource
panels.description: Gateway meters have no application label; per-application statement counts are in the portal (Queries page, GET /stats/queries/top?applicationId=).

panels.title: Statement latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: End-to-end statement latency at the gateway, including the wait for a physical connection (SLO buckets 1 ms … 30 s).

panels.title: Proxy: backend connect latency p95 by listener
panels.description: dbp_proxy_backend_connect_seconds publishes p50/p95/p99 as quantile series.

panels.title: Errors / s by SQLState
panels.description: Every ERROR frame the gateway sent, including rejected HELLOs (label sqlstate, lower-case).

panels.title: Telemetry ingest req/s
panels.description: POSTs to /api/v1/internal/telemetry/* (queries, connections, pools). The POC control plane has no custom dbp_* meters; components online and violations are on the portal.

panels.title: Control plane 5xx (5m)
panels.description: Server errors of the control plane API over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Internal API requests / s by endpoint
panels.description: Telemetry ingestion and heartbeats from gateways and proxies.

panels.title: Control plane API mean latency by endpoint
panels.description: rate(sum)/rate(count) of http_server_requests_seconds; Spring Boot exports no histogram buckets by default.

panels.title: Metadata store pool (HikariCP)
panels.description: Connections of the control plane to its PostgreSQL metadata store.

panels.title: Control plane JVM heap
panels.description: Gateway and proxy register no JVM meters in the POC; only the control plane exposes jvm_*.
